findings.title: Windows predecessor recovery cannot restore the exact pair and trusts an unbound HEAD state
findings.reproduction: At exact reviewed-state commit 24185cc42b5da841a244d331b2c37bb51171ffd2 on the release-authoritative Windows worktree, SHA-256 of the CRLF planning/backlog.yaml worktree bytes is the approved BACKLOG_SHA256 0b3d22f30d3a024e37b6c7b9b07d48f3a0b96dd2fc6c1968809a21d35a2977e7, while SHA-256 of `git show HEAD:planning/backlog.yaml` is the normalized LF blob 17aa5c98e5146c61786cacb1f27e0c0189cd806e51f5a600f53b7b71448c7526. tools/gcr2ctl.py restore_predecessor reads the backlog and state with taskctl.git_blob(repo, current HEAD, path), then requires the backlog Git-blob hash to equal the CRLF worktree constant. In a disposable real-Git clone of the frozen branch, preserve the exact witness, commit an unrelated GCR-0002 state while leaving the backlog unchanged, replace the live state with partial-publication bytes, create only GCR-0002.B00.adoption.lock, and run `python tools/gcr2ctl.py --repo . recover GCR-0002 --agent codex`. The command exits 1 with `GCR-0002 predecessor backlog Git blob is not the approved revision-8 boundary`, leaves the lock present, and leaves the partial state in place instead of producing either exact terminal pair. Independently, restore_predecessor selects both records from whatever current HEAD happens to be; require_recovery_workspace does not bind HEAD to the adoption-evidence commit or bind the selected state blob to the approved predecessor. A naive line-ending-only fix would therefore permit an unrelated committed state to become the restored canonical state. The passing recovery tests mask the production condition by setting core.autocrlf=false and patching BACKLOG_SHA256 to the fixture worktree hash in both the missing-manifest and crash loops; the crash loop also patches validate_successor_pair. The declared evidence therefore does not establish criterion 8's exact Windows predecessor-or-successor recovery boundary.
findings.requiredRemediation: In a strict-descendant candidate, make missing, invalid, stale, and partial-manifest recovery authenticate and restore the exact raw predecessor backlog and state independently of an unbound current HEAD. Bind the recovery base to the exact adoption-evidence/approved-state authority, preserve or otherwise deterministically reproduce both raw preimages across the CRLF Git/worktree boundary, validate both raw and canonical hashes plus the strict state schema before publication, and reject unrelated or stale HEAD/state sources without cleanup or mutation. Add real-Git Windows CRLF tests that do not patch BACKLOG_SHA256 or successor validation and cover missing and invalid manifests, stale/unrelated HEAD, substituted state, every declared child-process interruption boundary, repeated recovery, durable cleanup, and byte-exact predecessor-or-successor terminal pairs. Preserve this R01 ledger append-only and submit fresh R02 evidence with an explicit closure for GCR-0002.B00-R01-F01.
